data.title: H2H Facts - Football Predictions, Stats and Live Match Data
data.content:
No prediction is guaranteed. Team news, injuries, line-ups, motivation and events during a match can affect every result. H2H Facts provides informational football data and statistical analysis to support research, not certainty.

### H2H Records and Team Form [...] Head-to-head statistics show how two teams performed in earlier meetings. Combined with recent home and away form, goals scored, goals conceded and the latest results, H2H data can give a more complete view of an upcoming football match. Check both historical records and current performance rather than relying on one statistic.

### Fixtures, Results and League Statistics [...] Each match page is designed to make football research simpler. Depending on the available data, you can review recent team form, previous head-to-head meetings, league position, scoring trends, results and prediction markets. Use the information to understand a fixture better before making your own decision.
